hook: Andrew Foster is listed by Reuters Events as Chief Technology and Data Officer, M&T Bank, among the speakers at Momentum AI Finance 2026 in New York. According to Andrew Foster's LinkedIn profile, the title is chief data officer at M&T Bank, since March 2023, covering data and AI strategy; Reuters Events lists chief technology and data officer, and this page shows both.
